reviews.text: (Translated by Google) When I went at lunchtime, the place was crowded, and a waitress who appeared to be Chinese and dressed in black noticed us standing at the entrance for about 7 or 8 minutes. reviews.text: We had a bit of a strange experience here. The app charged me for sushi that I’d removed from my basket, which I didn’t realise until after I’d paid. I mentioned it to the waiter, who seemed just as baffled, so I ended up keeping the sushi anyway. Unfortunately, it was some of the worst sushi I’ve had. The app also automatically adds a tip, which you have to manually remove from your total. I find that quite odd? why am I being asked to tip before I’ve even had my food or received any service? Why am I being asked to tip at all for a QR code? The ramen broth was definitely the highlight of the meal, but overall, the rest was pretty disappointing especially as we were celebrating a birthday. Hopefully some improvements to the app and food quality are made, as there’s potential here.

reviews.author: Zen Cheung
reviews.text: It is usually difficult to eat high-quality ramen in the UK. If you want it, you have to drive all the way to get a chance to eat good ramen. But you never expected that this chain of Japanese ramen shops that are all around you would be such a surprise! I heard from a friend last time that I ate their ramen and thought the soup base was good, so we all tried it this time. I can't believe we were overjoyed. Their steak ramen is very good and the soup base is well-done and rich in flavor. The pork bone char siu ramen is definitely up to par. Maybe it's because the founder is from Hong Kong and went to Japan to study. So the overall quality is more Asian, and the taste is not spoiled due to localization. I give it a thumbs up. All in all, it's worth a try. I'll come back here next time when I'm craving for Japanese ramen.

reviews.author: Theo Chan
reviews.text: Had a really good experience at Maki & Ramen in Meadowhall. The food was really good, everything tasted fresh, and the staff were very friendly and helpful. We ordered the black garlic ramen and the hell ramen, and the flavour was really good. My only comment would be that I felt they could have been a little more generous with the soup, as I would have preferred a bit more broth. We also ordered the Black Dragon Roll. The flavours were great, but the sauce was a little too thin, so the rice absorbed it quite quickly and became a bit soggy. It’s only a small point, but a slightly thicker sauce would make it even better. There was also a small mix-up with one of the sushi rolls we ordered. However, as soon as we mentioned it, the staff spoke to the kitchen without hesitation and had the correct one remade for us. They even let us keep the original roll, which was a really nice gesture and showed great customer service. The only minor downside was that it could sometimes be difficult to find a member of staff when sitting in the lower-level seating area, as there wasn't always someone nearby. One other thing to note is that the lower-level seating area is accessed by a few stairs rather than a slope. It's only around 3–4 steps, so it’s not a major issue, but people with wheelchairs or strollers might find it a little difficult to access that area. Overall, it was a great experience with good food and excellent service. There are a few small things that could be improved, but I'd definitely come back again.

She assured us that our server will take us through the menu and help assure we are taken care of. If that would have happened I wouldnt be writing this. First of all, we was sat down and not a single server attended us for about 15 minutes, we was confused as we was handed a wallet at the start and all dishes apart from nagiri was containing gluten, when someone finally arrived to take orders, we had to explain our confusion and also explain that the wallet said nothing was gluten free, she explained that the vegitarian dish is the only gluten free dish... coeliacs arent rabbits! reviews.text: We came back again and decided to write a review this time. Our server was Kayleigh and she was really helpful with recommendations and was very positive with a great vibe. We sat by the bar/counter and it was a great experience seeing how they prepared food. Drinks were nice and food was delicious, will be coming back yet again!

reviews.author: Mercy Gandhi
reviews.text: Incredible experience, great food and an even better service. Everybody was helpful and Kayleigh was especially kind with us. Will visit again!

reviews.author: Fatmah Almutabagani
reviews.text: yummy food, incredible service by Nishant. Loved the calm atmosphere. A5 wagyu nigiri was the best bite of my life !!!!!

reviews.author: Zimu Zhang
reviews.text: The food was all stale, and the salmon actually smelled rotten. I can’t believe they would still sell it.

reviews.author: Ahmad
reviews.text: Kayleigh is the best!! Excellent service :)

reviews.author: aurelia
reviews.text: We came here before our show for a quick bite and it was amazing. We had Nishant as our server, he was really polite and had a great energy. The food was delicious, and all of the servers were super polite and nice. The music is nice, and the inside is decorated very nicely. We will be coming back!

reviews.author: John
reviews.text: Had a delicious meal for my wife’s birthday here. Thank you to Kayleigh for making it so special.

reviews.author: Steven Harbour
reviews.text: Up there with the best sushi I’ve ever had. Having recently visited Japan I can say the fish quality here is excellent. The handrolls were super crispy unlike other I have tried in London. Thank you to May, our server, for looking after us so well

reviews.author: Alex Maclean
reviews.text: Great experience, thanks for the help guys it was the best meal of my holiday!

reviews.author: Yuki Asuna
reviews.text: Honestly, the chef’s ceviche is really good. The crispy seaweed on top makes it even better and the seafood is always so fresh. Sometimes they even add octopus which I really like. Everything tastes fresh and well balanced. customer service is also rlly good, everyone is friendly and welcoming. Definitely recommend !!

reviews.author: Jim Amarui
reviews.text: The food is honestly so good! I really love the sauce from the crudo — sometimes I even drink it 😂 It’s that good. The seafood was so fresh, and I love that they make the sushi right in front of us tho. Even though the lighting was quite bright, I didn’t even have to ask the manager. She noticed and adjusted the lighting herself to make the whole atmosphere feel nicer and more elegant. Such a lovely attention to detail and amazing service. Definitely recommend Maki Nori! ❤️

reviews.author: Natalie M
reviews.text: It’s a gem! Great Japanese food, especially hand rolls, yellowtail carpaccio was also delicious!!! Good value for money! Not enough people know about this place!
